issues.issue: Was the RPD's decision to declare Mr. Abrazaldo's claim abandoned after he missed the show cause hearing reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Illness excused non-attendance; he intends to pursue the claim, it has merit, and the Minister suffers no prejudice; the consultant erred.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated; the court finds the RPD's reasons adequate and that the notice to appear warned of abandonment.
issues.result_quote: Mr. Abrazaldo has not shown any error on the part of the RPD or how its reasons are inadequate to support its decision
